signature.name: VTask.vecAppend
signature.type: {m n : ℕ} -> {α : Type u_1} -> {o : ℕ} -> (ho : o = m + n) -> (u : Fin m → α) -> (v : Fin n → α) -> Fin o → α

conventions.statement: For i : Fin o with (i : ℕ) < m, VTask.vecAppend ho u v i = u ⟨i, h⟩ where h : (i : ℕ) < m.
conventions.note: This is the casework rule for indices that fall within the range of the first vector u.

conventions.statement: For i : Fin o with ¬ (i : ℕ) < m, VTask.vecAppend ho u v i = v ⟨(i : ℕ) - m, _⟩.
conventions.note: This is the casework rule for indices that fall within the range of the second vector v, shifted by m.

conventions.statement: Any two proofs ho₁ ho₂ : o = m + n yield the same function VTask.vecAppend ho₁ u v = VTask.vecAppend ho₂ u v.
conventions.note: The proof ho is used only for reindexing and does not affect values.

facts.statement: ∀ {α : Type*} {n : ℕ} (v : Fin n → α), VTask.vecAppend rfl v ![] = v

facts.statement: ∀ {α : Type*} {n : ℕ} (v : Fin n → α), VTask.vecAppend n.zero_add.symm ![] v = v
